inverted_pyramid.title: The Inverted Pyramid Technique
inverted_pyramid.consulting_purpose: Directly addresses executive cognitive fatigue by answering the user question in under 3 seconds.
inverted_pyramid.example_question: Are we meeting our monthly revenue targets?
inverted_pyramid.layout_guidance: Top: 3-4 massive KPI blocks. Middle: actual vs target time-series. Bottom: underperformer table. Clean, uncluttered UI.
inverted_pyramid.color_guidance: Neutral chrome; high contrast only for a target miss (amber/red).
inverted_pyramid.design_application: Headline KPI with target delta, then monthly actual-vs-target line, then a transactional table of underperforming categories.

charts.title: Headline KPI vs target
charts.question_template: What is the headline KPI for: {question}? Include the current value and variance vs target.
charts.purpose: Answer the question in under 3 seconds.
charts.context_anchor: vs target and vs prior period

charts.title: Actual vs target trend
charts.question_template: Show the time-series of actual vs target for: {question}
charts.purpose: Give historical context under the headline KPI.

charts.title: Underperforming segments
charts.purpose: Show where to look next without cluttering the executive view.

progressive_disclosure.title: Progressive Disclosure (The Drill-Down Strategy)
progressive_disclosure.consulting_purpose: Eliminates data clutter and guides the user through an analytical journey.
progressive_disclosure.example_question: Why is engineering team attrition spiking?
progressive_disclosure.layout_guidance: Simple overview first, then a driver drill-down, then a dense detail table for export.
progressive_disclosure.color_guidance: Standard analytical palette; highlight outliers only.
progressive_disclosure.design_application: Main view shows the high-level breakdown. Follow-on charts uncover tenure, scores, or reason codes.

charts.title: Overview breakdown
charts.question_template: What is the high-level breakdown for: {question}?
charts.purpose: Keep the first view simple before drill-down.

charts.title: Root-cause slice
charts.purpose: Next layer using dimensions/metrics from the semantic model only.

charts.title: Detail extract
charts.question_template: Provide a detailed data table to explore: {question}
charts.purpose: Raw grid for hypothesis testing and export.

mece_metric_structuring.title: MECE Metric Structuring
mece_metric_structuring.consulting_purpose: Validates data trust by covering the topic fully without overlapping variables from the semantic model.
mece_metric_structuring.example_question: Why did travel cost change last quarter vs first quarter?
mece_metric_structuring.layout_guidance: Headline outcome comparison, then mutually exclusive dimension breakdowns from the semantic model, then period trend.
mece_metric_structuring.color_guidance: Consistent categorical colors per semantic dimension value.
mece_metric_structuring.design_application: Top: outcome metric for the compared periods. Middle: breakdown by real model dimensions (e.g. travel type, travel medium). Bottom: period trend. Never invent textbook levers like AOV or order volume unless they exist in the model.

charts.title: Core outcome
charts.question_template: What is the primary outcome KPI for: {question}?
charts.purpose: Anchor on the outcome metric named in the question / semantic model, with period comparison when asked.

charts.title: Dimension breakdown
charts.question_template: Break down {question} by the most relevant non-overlapping dimensions from the semantic model.
charts.purpose: MECE slice using categorical dimensions present in the semantic model only.

charts.title: Period shift
charts.question_template: How did the outcome for {question} move across the compared periods (monthly or quarterly)?
charts.purpose: Show period movement for the same outcome metric.

semantic_color_coding.title: Semantic Color Coding (Psychological UI)
semantic_color_coding.consulting_purpose: Alerts the business user where to focus immediate operational attention.
semantic_color_coding.example_question: Which fulfillment centers are running out of stock?
semantic_color_coding.layout_guidance: Visual focus on today's exceptions. Neutral for normal; amber/red for breaches.
semantic_color_coding.color_guidance: Gray for normal; amber or red as soon as a safety buffer or threshold is breached.
semantic_color_coding.design_application: Exception KPI, bottleneck/status breakdown, then an action list of failing nodes.

charts.title: Current blockers
charts.question_template: What needs attention right now for: {question}?

charts.title: Exception breakdown
charts.question_template: Where are the active bottlenecks or threshold breaches for: {question}?
charts.purpose: Point operational attention at failing nodes.

charts.title: Today's workflow
charts.question_template: List the current workflow items and statuses for: {question}
charts.purpose: Give the manager a daily action list.

intent_driven_layout.title: Intent-Driven Functional Layout
intent_driven_layout.consulting_purpose: Aligns the layout with the user's cadence of action (strategic vs operational).
intent_driven_layout.example_question: Is our budget allocation generating ROI?
intent_driven_layout.layout_guidance: Operational cadence: real-time blockers, caps, and status — not long-range strategy.
intent_driven_layout.color_guidance: High-contrast alerts for spikes, rejections, and cap breaches.
intent_driven_layout.design_application: For operators: CPC spikes, status rejections, daily budget caps. Keep the screen tied to this week's actions.

charts.title: Cadence KPI
charts.question_template: What is the operational headline for: {question}?
charts.purpose: Match the user's daily/weekly action cadence.
charts.context_anchor: vs daily cap or this week

charts.title: Live exceptions
charts.question_template: What real-time spikes, rejections, or cap breaches affect: {question}?

charts.title: Status board
charts.question_template: What is the current status board for: {question}?
charts.purpose: Operational checklist of items in flight.

so_what_contextual_anchoring.title: The So What? Contextual Anchoring
so_what_contextual_anchoring.consulting_purpose: Prevents arbitrary interpretation by pairing every value with target, history, or benchmark.
so_what_contextual_anchoring.example_question: Are patients waiting too long to see telehealth doctors?
so_what_contextual_anchoring.layout_guidance: Never show an isolated number. Pair KPIs with micro-trend and target labels.
so_what_contextual_anchoring.color_guidance: Flag values that miss the target; keep on-target metrics quiet.
so_what_contextual_anchoring.design_application: KPI as '14 Mins (▲ 4m vs Last Week | Target: < 10 Mins)', plus a sparkline/trend and the segments that miss the threshold.

charts.title: Anchored KPI
charts.question_template: What is the current value for: {question}? Include vs last period and vs target.

charts.title: Micro-trend
charts.question_template: Show the recent trend for: {question} against the target threshold.
charts.purpose: Give historical context beside the KPI.

charts.title: Missed-threshold segments
charts.question_template: Which segments miss the target for: {question}?
charts.purpose: Clarify where the threshold is breached.
